name: sage-lang
description: Sage language support, commands, and Test Explorer integration for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.test: node --test test/command.test.js test/manifest.test.js test/test-results.test.js test/grammar.test.js test/grammar-language.test.js test/diagnostics.test.js test/process.test.js test/project.test.js

sage.command.markdownDescription: Command used to invoke the Sage compiler. Quote paths containing spaces, for example `dotnet "C:/My Tools/Sage.dll"`. The target `.sg` file is appended automatically.

sage.testGlob.description: Glob pattern used to discover Sage test files for the Test Explorer.

sage.cleanBeforeRun.markdownDescription: Pass `--clean` to the compiler for **Run Current File** and Test Explorer runs, deleting cached objects in `obj/` first. Needs Sage 0.36.2 or newer. Use **Sage: Clean Build** for a one-off clean build.

enumDescriptions: Ask the compiler for structured diagnostics when its version supports them (Sage 0.35.0 or newer), otherwise parse the human format.
Always pass --diagnostics json. Requires Sage 0.35.0 or newer.
Never pass --diagnostics; parse the human format `file(line,col): error CODE: message`.
sage.diagnosticsFormat.markdownDescription: Diagnostics format requested from the compiler when **Run Current File** or the Test Explorer show errors in the Problems panel.
